name: Token prompt
description: A prompt field that highlights slash commands and at mentions as you type and offers an autocomplete menu for both.

default.name: /app_tools
default.desc: Start an app, list its tools

default: Run /app_tools on @formcut and list what it can do
Ask /suggest_app which app fits a job for @formmd pages
Use /call_app to run one tool from @formwav

propDocs.taskNode: Id of a hidden input node. On submit the component writes the task text there (the example when the field is empty) so the run script can echo it with an input token.
propDocs.countNode: Id of a hidden input node that receives how many apps the task reads (1 to 3).
propDocs.filesNode: Id of a hidden input node that receives the app names the task reads, joined by commas.
propDocs.runNode: Id of the submit button. It is disabled while a run is on screen.
propDocs.logNode: Id of the run log. It is made inert until a run has started.
propDocs.doneNode: Id of the done bar. It is made inert until the run has finished.
propDocs.scopeNode: Id of the section root. The pointer position is written there as --kx and --ky for the dot grid and glow.
propDocs.startedVariable: Name of the boolean variable the run script sets true at submit and the New task action sets false.
propDocs.finishedVariable: Name of the boolean variable the run script sets true when the last step is done.
propDocs.transportVariable: Name of the number variable (0 or 1) the transport buttons set.
propDocs.transportNodes: Ids of the transport buttons in variable order; the component keeps their aria-checked in step with the variable.
propDocs.commands: Array of {name, desc}. Names start with a slash.
propDocs.apps: Array of {name, path, desc}. Names start with an at sign; path is the word matched while typing.
propDocs.examples: Array of task strings. Tab on an empty field fills the next one; New task moves on to the following one.

fallback: Without scripts the poster shows the empty field. With reduced motion the field works the same; only the menu pop animation is dropped.
